terms.meaning: the record of which incidents or sources a story is based on
a value a title is built from, such as a team name or a count

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports the sport type
sections.what: Loads the sport type so each story records a valid sport.
sections.why: Keeps story sports to the known list.

sections.name: Story
sections.title: One story
sections.what: Describes one story: its kind, title, parameters, size, priority, time, source and evidence.
sections.why: Gives everything a card needs and a trail back to the source.
sections.watch_out: The size means different things for each kind, so do not compare sizes across kinds.

summary: Defines the shape of one story card.
purpose: Fixes what each story records so the Desk can display it and trace it back to its evidence.
why: Fields such as receipts exist so each story can be traced to its incidents, as the file comments say.
how: Lists the sport, kind, English title, the parameters used for titles, size, priority, time, source id and receipts.
inputs: None at run time; these are types only.
outputs: A type used by the story detectors.
risks: The title is stored in English only, and Hindi titles are built from the parameters when shown.
debug: If a story shows the wrong evidence, check its receipts list.
